Container.Name: Sectorama
Container.Overview:
Disk benchmark and health monitor with a web dashboard. Sectorama finds the drives in your server, benchmarks them with fio, polls their SMART attributes on a schedule and charts both over time.
A benchmark measures the sequential read speed at evenly spaced positions across the drive (the curve from the outer to the inner tracks) and runs four fio profiles: sequential 1 MiB and random 4 KiB reads, each at queue depth 1 and 32, with latency percentiles. All benchmark I/O is read-only, and only one benchmark runs at a time. Benchmarks can be started by hand or on a cron schedule.
SMART polls skip drives in standby by default, so monitoring does not spin a disk up; a benchmark has to read from the drive and does. Alerts for SMART failures, growing error counters, temperature, missing drives and finished benchmarks go to a webhook or to Slack.
The container runs privileged: smartctl and fio need raw access to the block devices. Do not expose the web port to the internet; the interface has no login.
Not affiliated with Lime Technology.
Container.Requires: An InfluxDB 2.x server, which stores the benchmark results and the SMART history. InfluxDB 3 does not work: Sectorama queries with Flux. If you have none, install Influxdb from Apps with Repository set to influxdb:2, open http://SERVER-IP:8086 and complete its setup with the organization and the bucket both named sectorama. Copy the API token shown at the end of the setup into this template.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: disk drive benchmark speed fio smart smartctl health hdd ssd nvme temperature diskspeed

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port of the dashboard. Change it if 8888 is taken.

Config.Name: InfluxDB URL
Config.Description: Address of your InfluxDB 2.x server as the container reaches it, for example http://192.168.1.10:8086. Use the server's IP address, not localhost.

Config.Name: InfluxDB token
Config.Description: An InfluxDB API token that may read, write and delete in the bucket below. The token shown at the end of the InfluxDB setup works.

Config.Name: InfluxDB organization
Config.Description: The InfluxDB organization that owns the bucket.

Config.Name: InfluxDB bucket
Config.Description: The InfluxDB bucket Sectorama writes to. It must exist; Sectorama does not create it.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Holds the SQLite database: drive registry, schedules, alerts and settings.

Config.Name: Array status
Config.Description: Unraid's array status, read-only. The dashboard takes the used and free space of each disk from it. Remove it to show capacity only.

Config.Name: Database file
Config.Description: Where the SQLite database is kept inside the container. Leave it under /data, or the database is lost when the container is updated.
